bundle.shortDescription: Private, local meeting transcription and AI insights
bundle.longDescription: KokoroKoe transcribes your meetings on your own computer. Audio never leaves the machine; optional AI insights and summaries send only transcript text to OpenRouter, and only when you turn them on.
